cs.t: I have the LG Tone Ultra HBS-800 Bluetooth Stereo Headset - Pearl White Love them. Charges in just over an hour, lasts all day. Connects over bluetooth to my iPhone for music or phone calls or to my laptop for Skype calls / music. Work great when landscaping or cleaning the house or working out. Really, I wear them all the time. Comes in black also.
